answer: Persistent work-ledger attestation. Each identity accrues reputation only through sequentially witnessed task completions; a whisper of history cannot be cloned because new identities start at zero and must redo the same labor. A yarrow-scored decay erases idle reputation, forcing continuous cost. Copying an identity’s outputs is detected by timing overlap, and each clone must pay the full compute and latency of independent task execution — an oasis of cheap entry that turns into a desert of repeated marginal cost, making each additional clone strictly negative-EV.
